mission_07: CutMix is a region-based data augmentation technique that combines two images by cutting a rectangular patch from one and pasting it onto the other. Unlike Mixup which blends entire images, CutMix preserves the local structure of both images, making it more intuitive and often more effective. The label is mixed proportionally to the area ratio of the pasted patch, providing a natural weighting scheme. CutMix has been shown to outperform both Mixup and standard augmentation on image classification benchmarks. It forces the model to learn from partial objects and contextual cues, improving localization ability and robustness. The technique is simple to implement, computationally efficient, and works as a drop-in replacement in most training pipelines.
